verses.1: And God said to Jacob, “Get up, go into the house of God. There, prepare a sacrifice for the God who appears to you while you are fleeing from your brother Esau.”
verses.2: And Jacob said to his house and to all those who were with him, “Take away the gods of those nations from among you. Purify yourselves, and change your clothes.”
verses.3: And I will weep and mourn in the house of God. There, I will offer sacrifices to the God who has saved me on the day of my distress. He will stand with me along the path I have taken.
verses.4: And they gave to Jacob all the gods of the nations they had conquered. They also gave him the idols that they had in their hands. Jacob placed them under the altar that stood with its cover.
verses.5: And they went away. Then God’s anger was kindled against the cities around them. But they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.6: And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan. It was the house of El; and all the people who lived there were there too.
verses.7: And there he built an altar. He called that place “Elohim’s House,” because it was there that God revealed himself to him, away from his brothers.
verses.8: And her words were taken away from Rebekah. She was buried under the house of El, beneath the earth. And their name was called “Alon.”
verses.9: And God saw Jacob again as he was coming out of Egypt. And He blessed him.
verses.10: And God said to him, “Your name will never be called again by Jacob, unless Israel exists. Then your name will be called again.” And he named him Israel.
verses.11: And God said to him, “I am the Lord your God. Many nations will be destroyed by you. Kings will come from among your people.”
verses.12: And the land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you and your descendants.
verses.13: And God stood above him in the place where He spoke to him.
verses.14: And Jacob stood in the place where he had spoken with Abraham. He laid a covering over it, and poured tar over it.
verses.15: And Jacob called out the name of the place where God spoke to him. It was the house of El.
verses.16: And they traveled from the house of El. Then, as it was still dark, Ephratah came out. Rachel gave birth to a son.
verses.17: And it happened that, during her birth, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid; this is also a blessing for you.”
verses.18: And when she died, her soul departed. Her name was called Ben-Ouni, and her father called her Binyamin.
verses.19: Rachael died and was buried along the path to Ephratah. That’s where the house of Lahem is located.
verses.20: And Jacob stood on Rachel’s grave. He remains standing on Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.21: And Israel went forth, and they set up an altar at Mount Eder.
verses.22: And it happened that Israel lived in that land. Reuben went and buried his father, Bilha. Israel heard about this, and the sons of Jacob became twenty-two in number.
verses.23: The sons of Levi were: Reuben, Shimon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.24: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.25: And the sons of Bilha, the daughter of Rahel, were Dan and Naphtali.
verses.26: And the sons of Zilpha, the daughter of Lameh, were Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
verses.27: And Jacob went to his father Isaac. He visited the place where his brother Esau was living, along with Abraham and Isaac.
verses.28: And there were days during Isaac’s life, in the year of two hundred and fifty years.
verses.29: Isaac died, and his people gathered around him. They were old and had lived for seventy years. They buried him together with Esau and Jacob, his sons.
